messages:
Olivia Chen: Planning check-in for the May webinar: goal = 1) showcase Redwood Optimize, 2) short benchmarks + real customer story, 3) clear CTA to sign up for Dedicated trial. Need abstracts, who owns the customer story, rehearsal windows, and a fallback plan.
Samir Rao: I can own the customer story — talking partner from Collabra (they used Dedicated). Will ask for 3 bullet outcomes.
Priya Nair: Draft abstract (2 lines): "Practical playbook for cutting inference costs 30% using batching, cache, and routing. Includes measured before/after numbers."
Olivia Chen: Good. Shorten to one sentence for the landing: "Cut inference spend by ~30% with batching, caching, and smart routing	6 a playbook from Redwood and customers."
Tom Everett: Rehearsal availability: Mon 10-11am PT or Thu 2-3pm PT. Prefer Mon.
Lia Martinez: I can narrate the benchmark slide deck and prep the two comparison charts. Headshot + 1-liner due Friday.
Olivia Chen: Run-of-show suggestion (35m total):

00:00-02:00 Welcome + agenda (Olivia)
02:00-09:00 Benchmark story + what we measured (Lia)
09:00-18:00 Customer success highlight (Samir + Collabra clip)
18:00-26:00 Live demo: Optimize panel + routing (Tom)
26:00-32:00 Rapid tips + 3 action items (Priya)
32:00-35:00 CTA + poll + wrap (Olivia)

Olivia Chen: Keep customer clip <=90s. Demo must be scripted with backup screenshots.
Tom Everett: For demo fallback: if live model latency >700ms we switch to pre-rendered screen share. ops-bot: Added fallback entry to the runbook: if latency_threshold_exceeded -> swap_to_prerecord and notify channel #marketing-webinars.
Priya Nair: Poll idea during wrap: "Which would you try first? A) Batching B) KV caching C) Model quantization D) Smart routing"
Samir Rao: Collabra will provide a short quote + a 30s clip. I'll get sign-off by Thursday.
Olivia Chen: Production notes: need S3 path for prerecord, two slide versions (live + screenshots), Zoom co-host list, and a runbook snippet showing who hits the "share screen" button.
Lia Martinez: Uploading charts to shared drive now. Chart notes: baseline = 1.0x cost, optimized = 0.72x.
Tom Everett: Can ops-bot add a simple smoke test we can run 30min before show? e.g., 10 sample requests at expected token length.
ops-bot: Smoke test template created. Command: `python smoke_test.py --host webinar-demo.redwood.ai --model rdx-7b --samples 10`. Results auto-post to #marketing-webinars.
Olivia Chen: Love that. Rehearsal schedule: Mon 10am dry run (20m) + Wed 3pm full run (35m). Invite sent.
Priya Nair: Will shorten slides to 8 and drop non-essential animations.
Samir Rao: Collabra clip delivery ETA: Thu 18:00 PT.
Lia Martinez: Sharing final charts by Thu EOD.
Tom Everett: I'll script the demo steps in the runbook with expected outputs and timecodes.
Olivia Chen: Social copy: draft 1 for review by EOD today. Also need a short landing description (max 120 chars).
Priya Nair: Landing desc suggestion: "Real-world playbook to lower LLM inference cost and improve latency. Live demos + customer results."
Olivia Chen: Nice. Final ask: everyone upload headshot + 1-sentence bio to the assets folder by Friday noon. ops-bot: Calendar invites and recording enabled for rehearsals.
Samir Rao: Will confirm Collabra clip delivery.
Lia Martinez: A11y note: provide alt text for charts and a transcript of demo.
Olivia Chen: Great callout, Lia. We'll add transcript requirement to deliverables. Closing: reach out here for urgent changes. Thanks! :sparkles:
